sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find all green blocks
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")
targets = []
for n in green_nodes:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    targets.append((center_row, center_col))
    print(f"  center=({center_row}, {center_col})")

# Find player
player = None
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'Y':
        player = n
        break
print(f"\nPlayer: col={player['boundary'][0][1]}")

# Collect all green blocks
if targets:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in targets], intent='solve')
    print(f"\nAfter collecting: done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"Green blocks remaining: {len(green_nodes)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
